problems: WebFetch summarises: every quotation in the dossiers is the extraction's wording; the Vietnam War page extract was cut off before 1969, so the Vietnam War entry in the PRG dossier rests on two control statements only.

No page opened gives a boundary for any insurgent zone (CPB, KNU, KIO, Wa, MTA, KMT, PRG before 1975, CGDK): regions are named provinces, township circles or the siblings' own Thai-frontier strip, all soft; most are confidence 2 and the placements flagged confidence 1 are the Wa South circle, the KMT 1951 extent, the Tachileik/Pegu capital stand-ins and the Cambodia/Burma Thai-border losses.

Counterpart mismatches for gap-fillers: people-s-republic-of-kampuchea uses 'khmer-rouge' for the Thai-border zone that coalition-government-of-democratic-kampuchea mirrors under 'people-s-republic-of-kampuchea'; union-of-burma, republic-of-indonesia, dutch-east-indies, republic-of-vietnam and french-indochina have no mirror events for the gains and losses recorded here (PRG 1972-75, KMT, KNU, KIO, CPB, Wa, MNDAA, AA, PRRI losses, State of East Indonesia).

state-of-vietnam and republic-of-vietnam (se-04-b) are one state in the pages (Bao Dai's State of Vietnam became Diem's Republic on 26 October 1955); I wrote the earlier years as a separate dossier with the republic as successor, and a gap-filler should merge them under one colour if they agree.

Three open contests end 2024 with a contest_start that has no contest_end and the validator reports each as a warning: karen-national-union (from March 2021), kachin-independence-organization (from June 2011) and arakan-army (from January 2024). wa-state ends 2024 as a live de facto state with no open contest.
Validator warning remaining under --resolve: mong-tai-army names 'shan-state-national-army', which has no dossier yet (listed in counterparts_needing_dossiers); the other counterparts resolve.
